info.title: Needly API
info.description:
Backend API for Needly, a real-time shared shopping and household coordination application.

The server supports TLS when started with `TLS_CERT_FILE` and `TLS_KEY_FILE` environment variables set.

All requests may include an `API-Version` header (e.g. `API-Version: 1`) to pin to a specific API version. If omitted, the latest version is used.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Unique key (e.g. a UUID) generated per queued mutation. Retrying the same POST with the same key returns the original response instead of executing again. Responses with status >= 500 are not stored; records expire after 24 hours.
